title: SensZ.AI | Alai Labs
description: An edge AI module with an IP67 outdoor sensor, for object detection and live volume and weight measurement.

head.p_1: An edge AI module with an IP67 outdoor sensor, for object detection and live volume and weight measurement.

img_1.alt: Three scenes for SensZ.AI sensors: a field, a drain and a street bin with a fill-level display

about.caption_1: Existing image. Photos and a video of the product at work are to come; the video will play only when you press play.
about.p_1: SensZ.AI puts a trained model next to the sensor, so detection happens on site rather than in the cloud. The sensor is rated IP67 for outdoor use, and the module supports custom models for object detection and real-time measurement of volume and weight.
